advice.text: Fronts saturate under braking before turn-in: brake pressure DOWN toward the knee, then balance 2-3% rearward.
advice.evidence: 10/30 corners red on the fronts in phase 1

advice.text: Mid-corner understeer: front ARB -2 clicks or front springs softer (mech balance up); if only in fast corners, aero balance forward instead.
advice.evidence: USI median +0.279 over 30 corners (19 understeer, 3 mid-corner front reds)

advice.text: Trail-brake understeer: finish more braking before steering; caster +0.5 for camber-in-turn.
advice.evidence: 10/30 corners red on the fronts at turn-in

advice.text: Suspension hits full compression at speed: ride height up a notch or springs stiffer (verify on the HUD Suspension page).
advice.evidence: 767 bottoming frames above 40 mph (detector still coarse)

advice.text: Brake-lock pattern inconsistent across 6 stops (1 both-axle, 0 front-first, 0 rear-first) — more hard stops from 80+ mph before touching balance.
Balance varies corner to corner (USI spread 0.52) — likely speed-dependent (mechanical vs aero). Split the verdict by corner speed before tuning.
